headline: Cambridge Technology reports Q2 results and subsidiary divestment
hook: Cambridge Technology exits subsidiary FA Software

modes.bear: Selling a wholly owned subsidiary may indicate a need for liquidity or a retreat from previous expansion efforts.
modes.bull: Divesting non-core subsidiaries can streamline operations and improve focus on primary business segments.
modes.simple: Cambridge Technology released its latest financial results and decided to sell its subsidiary, FA Software Services. They are also moving a loan related to that business to another firm.

summary: Cambridge Technology Enterprises approved its standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The board also authorized the assignment of a loan receivable from its subsidiary, FA Software Services, to Aglow Financial Services. Additionally, the company confirmed the full divestment of its 100% stake in FA Software Services. These corporate restructuring moves follow the release of the company's latest half-year financial performance.
why_it_matters: Divestment changes the company's asset base and future revenue stream.
